lines.speaker: trader_sable
lines.text: Your machine has been staring at the relay mast for an hour. It has not blinked, which I appreciate is not a thing it does.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: It is my channel. I have been the only thing on it since the racks came down and I have been saying one line incorrectly the entire time.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I would like to say it correctly, once, on the channel it was meant for. I am aware of how that sounds.
